name: Glasses startup preserves saved preference semantics
step: Check the glasses startup reader and registration
rationale: The startup scalar reader replaces the full INI/settings reader on the path that decides whether main.init registers glasses support. The harness runs both real readers against the same in-memory file, checking section isolation, repeated keys/sections, boolean and numeric values, invalid/missing values, whitespace, comments, CRLF and handle closure. It also runs the real main.init with unrelated subsystem registration stubbed: an enabled preference registers once, an opted-out startup stays opted out until reload, and an absent API causes neither a settings read nor registration. The existing glasses widget and other subsystem initialization remain independent. No package or build step otherwise exercises this runtime behavior.
